name: Sodium radiation pressure and shadow gating
purpose: Verify production Na force dispatch adds radiation only when illuminated.
production_capability: Moon::TotalParticleAcceleration radiation branch and linked mover.
configuration: DE421 neutral Na; paired +/-3 lunar-radii fixtures; dt=0.25 s.
independent_reference: U03/U04 non-radiative analytical force sum; U05 independently digitized Combi curve.
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred rotating LSO at frozen SPICE epoch.
procedure: Subtract independent non-radiative acceleration from raw production totals and inspect mover steps.
acceptance_criteria: Shadow residual <=1e-12 m s^-2; lit residual is nonzero, radial, and anti-+X for the production heliocentric vector convention.
expected_pass_result: Radiation is present only in the lit state and points correctly.
status_semantics: PASS verifies linked gating; observational sodium agreement is not claimed.
